name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
publisher: Stability AI (Large, Large Turbo, Medium, Large ControlNets); Comfy-Org repacks the ungated all-in-one fp8 checkpoints and ControlNets

gated_downloads.note: stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3.5-* (originals and ControlNet originals) are gated: 'Access to model ... is restricted. You must have access to it and be authenticated'. The Comfy-Org repacks (stable-diffusion-3.5-fp8, stable-diffusion-3.5-controlnets_ComfyUI_repackaged) are ungated and are what every official template loads.

cannot.what: ControlNets on Medium or Turbo: 'compatible only with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large (8b)' (Turbo compatibility NOT FOUND)
resolutions above ~1 MP on Large ('supports up to 1 megapixel resolution'); Medium is '0.25 to 2 megapixel'
factual depictions: 'The model was not trained to be factual or true representations of people or events'
strong negative prompts: they 'actively harm quality and cause color banding' on SD3/3.5 (community-confirmed; the official default negative is the empty string)
img2img / inpaint with a validated SD3.5 graph: no template; only the generic VAEEncode / VAEEncodeForInpaint pattern ('SD3.5-specific validation: NOT FOUND')
IP-Adapter / CLIP-vision image prompting: NOT FOUND (none official or Comfy-Org)

comfyui.nodes_read_from: v0.38.1 source per the dossier (comfy_extras/nodes_sd3.py, nodes_model_advanced.py, nodes_controlnet.py, comfy/supported_models.py, comfy/latent_formats.py); input names taken from the v0.35.0 registry (node_schemas_v0.35.0.json)
comfyui.nodes_verified_against_registry: v0.35.0 - all 8 recipes passed verify_recipes.py on 2026-10-02
comfyui.sd3_config: class SD3: sampling_settings shift 3.0; latent_format SD3 (16 ch, scale 1.5305, shift 0.0609); memory_usage_factor 1.6; text encoders detected under the text_encoders. prefix -> sd3_clip(clip_l, clip_g, t5)
comfyui.note: Nothing is version-pending: every template needs <= 0.3.42. ControlNetApplySD3 is deprecated (is_deprecated=True in v0.38.1; the v0.35.0 registry marks it deprecated too) - every recipe uses ControlNetApplyAdvanced with its vae input wired.

bytes_note: The dossier records HF tree-API sizes as decimal GB to three places; exact byte counts are NOT FOUND in the KB, so bytes is null and size_gb carries the dossier figure. Phase 2 reads exact bytes from the HF tree on the box.

community_alternatives.what: GGUF Large / Large Turbo / Medium (city96) for small cards; ungated route to Turbo

DualCLIPLoader(clip_l, clip_g, type 'sd3') without T5, or CLIPLoader(t5xxl, type 'sd3') alone: 'SD3 supports different text encoder configurations' - both sit unconnected in the Comfy-Org workflow JSONs
time-limited negative: real negative for the first ~10% of steps (ConditioningSetTimestepRange 0.0-0.1) + ConditioningZeroOut for 0.1-1.0, joined with ConditioningCombine
preprocessors other than Canny (blur, depth maps from other estimators): comfyui_controlnet_aux ('Please use the preprocessed images, or install comfyui_controlnet_aux')

params.name: steps
params.interactions: Turbo: 4 only; ControlNets: HF card 'slightly higher step count (50-60) ... especially with Canny'; HF Large card example 28

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; SD3.5 likes it low
params.interactions: HF Large card 'guidance_scale 3.5-4.5'; cfg >> 5 hurts Large; Turbo cfg 1.0-1.2; SLG oversaturates -> lower cfg; the depth template's 8 is the family outlier

params.name: sampler_name / scheduler
params.interactions: community: 'simple Euler/sgm_uniform with 25 steps ... dpmpp_2m sampler gives nice results for general use in the Medium model'

params.name: shift
params.meaning: timestep shift of the flow schedule; SD3.5's config value is 3.0, which is also the node default, so the templates omit the node entirely
params.interactions: adding the node is only useful to move AWAY from 3.0 - an experiment, not an official setting

params.name: width / height
params.interactions: control-depth takes its size from the depth map (VAEEncode latent) - use the megapixels port; community (single source): dimensions divisible by 64

params.name: strength / start_percent / end_percent
params.meaning: ControlNet weight and the fraction of the schedule it acts on
params.interactions: HF card: 'start with a ControlNet strength of 0.7-0.8'; the vae input MUST be wired for SD3.5 ControlNets

params.name: Skip Layer Guidance
params.meaning: guides with the difference to a pass that skips transformer layers 7-9 early in the schedule; Stability's Medium recommendation ('ComfyUI PR #5404')
params.interactions: community: 'SLG tends to oversaturate images with some loss of detail, so the CFG and ModelSampling need to be tuned down'; experimental node

params.name: text encoder set
params.meaning: clip_l, clip_g, t5xxl in that order ('Recipes: sd3: clip-l, clip-g, t5')
params.interactions: T5 handles long prompts (256 tokens in later training stages), CLIP-L/G 77 tokens; CLIPTextEncodeSD3 (clip_l, clip_g, t5xxl texts + empty_padding none|empty_prompt) can send different text to each encoder - the official templates use one CLIPTextEncode

params.name: canny thresholds
params.meaning: edge detector sensitivity on the 1024x1024 scaled image
params.interactions: HF card reference preprocessing is cv2.Canny(100, 200) on grayscale

rules.message: SD3.5 is a 16-channel latent (latent_format SD3): the empty latent is EmptySD3LatentImage, never the 4-channel EmptyLatentImage

sd3.5_large / sd3.5_large_turbo / sd3.5_medium 'do not contain text encoder/CLIP weights so you must load them separately': TripleCLIPLoader(clip_l, clip_g, t5xxl) feeds the text encoders; the checkpoint's CLIP output is empty for these files
TripleCLIPLoader order for SD3 is clip_l, clip_g, t5 ('Recipes: sd3: clip-l, clip-g, t5'): T5 goes in clip_name3
'I recommend t5xxl_fp16.safetensors if you have more than 32GB ram or t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors if you don't' - fine on a box with >32 GB system RAM, otherwise switch to the fp8 scaled T5
SD3.5 Large Turbo is ADD-distilled: cfg 1.0 (reference) to 1.2 (ComfyUI_examples); normal cfg 4-5 'wastes the distillation and can over-guide'
Turbo is a 4-step model ('set steps to 4'; reference steps 4); 20-40 steps waste time and do not add quality
SD3.5 Large runs at cfg 4.5 (reference), 3.5-4.5 (card), 4.01-5.45 (templates); the depth template's 8 is the top of the official range - above it expect over-guiding
with Skip Layer Guidance the reference cfg drops from 5.0 to 4.0: 'SLG tends to oversaturate images ... so the CFG and ModelSampling need to be tuned down'
Skip Layer Guidance is Stability's recommendation for SD3.5-Medium ('better structure and anatomy coherency from SD3.5-Medium'); the Large / Turbo reference configs do not use it

every official SD3.5 template uses an EMPTY negative (or ConditioningZeroOut of the positive); 'strong negatives like "blurry, distorted, ugly" actively harm quality and cause color banding' on SD3/3.5 - keep it empty, or time-limit it (ConditioningSetTimestepRange 0-0.1 + ConditioningZeroOut 0.1-1)
the SD3.5 ControlNets 'are compatible only with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large (8b)': not Medium; Turbo compatibility NOT FOUND

SD3.5 ControlNets need the VAE: wire the checkpoint's VAE into ControlNetApplyAdvanced.vae (every SD3.5 ControlNet template does); the old 'Apply Controlnet with VAE' (ControlNetApplySD3) is deprecated
ControlNetApplySD3 ('Apply Controlnet with VAE') is deprecated (is_deprecated=True; the v0.35.0 registry flags it): use ControlNetApplyAdvanced with its vae input
EmptySD3LatentImage takes width/height in multiples of 16 (node step 16; 8x spatial VAE on a 2x patch)
SD3.5's config shift is 3.0 for every variant (Large, Turbo, Medium, ControlNets) - the node default - so the templates omit ModelSamplingSD3; another value is an experiment, not an official setting
official SD3.5 ControlNet strengths are 0.66 (canny), 0.7 (depth), 1.0 (blur); HF card: 'start with a ControlNet strength of 0.7-0.8' - above 1.0 is outside anything official
the recipe's template needs a newer ComfyUI than the pinned image (none of the SD3.5 templates does: max 0.3.42)

prompting.negative_gloss: the empty string; the ControlNet templates use ConditioningZeroOut(positive) as the negative

positive.line: Natural-language description; T5 takes long prompts (256 tokens in later training stages), CLIP-L/G 77 tokens
Template prompts are one dense descriptive sentence: 'a bottle with a pink and red galaxy inside it on top of a wooden table ... with a window to the outdoors mountain range bright sun clouds forest'
Stability's reference prompts are descriptive sentences ('A Night time photo taken by Leica M11, portrait of a Japanese woman in a kimono, looking at the camera, Cherry blossoms')
Text in the image: the HF card's convention is to quote the string; no official typography prompt-format guidance was found (NOT FOUND)
CLIPTextEncodeSD3 lets tags go to clip_l/clip_g and prose to t5xxl; the official templates use a single CLIPTextEncode

hurts.line: heavy negative prompts ('blurry, distorted, ugly'): quality loss and colour banding - the opposite of SDXL habits
Skip Layer Guidance on Medium without lowering cfg (oversaturation)

pitfalls.symptom: download of sd3.5_large / turbo / medium / the original ControlNets fails with 'Access to model ... is restricted'
pitfalls.fix: use the ungated Comfy-Org repacks: sd3.5_large_fp8_scaled, sd3.5_medium_incl_clips_t5xxlfp8scaled, the text_encoders folder, and stable-diffusion-3.5-controlnets_ComfyUI_repackaged

pitfalls.symptom: empty / broken conditioning with an original checkpoint (CLIP output of CheckpointLoaderSimple is empty)
pitfalls.cause: sd3.5_large.safetensors, sd3.5_large_turbo.safetensors, sd3.5_medium.safetensors contain no text encoders
pitfalls.fix: TripleCLIPLoader(clip_l, clip_g, t5xxl) feeding both CLIPTextEncode nodes (t2i-large-triple-clip / t2i-large-turbo)

pitfalls.symptom: ControlNet errors or garbage on Medium
pitfalls.cause: the ControlNets 'are compatible only with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large (8b)'
pitfalls.fix: Large fp8 all-in-one checkpoint for every control recipe

pitfalls.symptom: 'Apply Controlnet with VAE' node flagged deprecated / graph rejected
pitfalls.cause: ControlNetApplySD3 is deprecated in v0.38.1 and in the v0.35.0 registry
pitfalls.fix: ControlNetApplyAdvanced with its vae input wired to the checkpoint VAE

pitfalls.symptom: depth recipe ignores the requested width/height
pitfalls.cause: the shipped depth template feeds VAEEncode(depth map) as the latent, so the output takes the depth map's size
pitfalls.fix: use the megapixels port (output = input scaled to N MP, aspect kept) or wire an EmptySD3LatentImage to the KSampler as the template note says

pitfalls.cause: Turbo run at 20-40 steps and cfg 4-5

pitfalls.fix: t2i-medium-slg (SkipLayerGuidanceSD3 layers 7,8,9) and lower cfg to 4.0 because SLG oversaturates

pitfalls.symptom: colour banding, degraded quality with a 'normal' negative prompt
pitfalls.cause: SD3/3.5 negatives behave opposite to SDXL
pitfalls.fix: empty negative (the official default) or a time-limited negative via ConditioningSetTimestepRange + ConditioningZeroOut + ConditioningCombine

pitfalls.cause: t5xxl_fp16 on a box with <= 32 GB RAM

pitfalls.symptom: old workflow says models/clip, files are in models/text_encoders
pitfalls.cause: folder renamed; both paths are scanned

pitfalls.symptom: blur recipe gives a different picture, not a refined one
pitfalls.cause: an unblurred image was fed; the template expects a pre-blurred input and has no in-graph blur
pitfalls.fix: blur upstream (HF card: GaussianBlur kernel 50) or install comfyui_controlnet_aux
